name: Joel Gilbert

summary.text: Joel Iverson Gilbert was a partner at the Birmingham law firm Balch & Bingham. In July 2018 a federal jury convicted him and Drummond Company executive David Roberson of bribery, honest services wire fraud, conspiracy and money laundering for paying Alabama representative Oliver Robinson, through a consulting contract with Robinson's foundation, to oppose EPA Superfund action in north Birmingham. Gilbert drafted the talking points Robinson used with EPA and an anti-EPA state resolution. He was sentenced to five years; the Eleventh Circuit affirmed in 2020.
